tasks.title: Set up PostgreSQL database schema with tables for users, flowers, categories, orders, cart items, and reviews
Build Node.js/Express REST API with endpoints for flower catalog, cart management, order placement, and user authentication
Integrate Stripe API for secure payment processing and webhook handling for order confirmation
Develop React web application with Home, Flower Detail, Shopping Cart, and Checkout screens following the design specifications
Create reusable UI components (Product Card, Primary Button, Text Input, Status Badge, Toast Notification) matching the design system
Implement order tracking functionality with status updates and SendGrid email notifications for customers
Build Admin Dashboard with order management, inventory updates, and status filter capabilities
Implement responsive mobile-first design with bottom navigation, touch-optimized interactions, and accessibility features (WCAG 2.1 AA)
Add product search functionality with filtering by category and price range
Implement user authentication and authorization with role-based access (Customer, Admin, Delivery Driver)

risks: Stripe payment integration complexity may cause delays in checkout functionality
Database performance issues with concurrent order processing during peak times
Third-party API dependencies (Stripe, SendGrid) may experience downtime affecting core features
Mobile responsive design testing across multiple devices may reveal layout inconsistencies
Insufficient inventory management logic could lead to overselling of out-of-stock items
